title: Keep each member once
summary: A set holds unique members without a promised order.
introduction: A set holds unique members without a promised order. Your task: Add one new name and one duplicate name.
learningObjectives: Add one new name and one duplicate name.
Explain the example for keep each member once

blocks.text: A set holds unique members without a promised order. Adding a duplicate does not make another copy.
Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.

blocks.code:
DEL cma:readers
SADD cma:readers Mia Sam Mia
SCARD cma:readers
blocks.title: Keep each member once

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `SADD` adds unique set members. A duplicate member does not increase the set size.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not rely on the order returned by set member listings. Sets are about membership, not sequence.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add one new name and one duplicate name.
